description.value: Bean Scene is a pioneer of third wave coffee in the Okanagan, roasting small-batch, hand-crafted espresso since 2002 using a vintage 12 kg Probat roaster retrofitted with an emission control system. The company operates multiple locations across Kelowna and runs its own wholesale bakery, producing fresh scratch-baked goods daily with local ingredients. Touring cyclists will find a serious, independent coffee culture with baristas trained to international competition standards.

bike_parking_detail: 2 racks within 100m: lockers (secure) at 36m; lockers (secure) at 38m.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms Bean Scene is a real, actively operating specialty coffee roaster and multi-location cafe in Kelowna, with the homepage explicitly stating all locations are back to regular operations; the OSM check_date of 2025-11-11 further supports this. The website mentions an in-house bakery and online shop but does not explicitly confirm bike parking, washrooms, water refill, Wi-Fi, or takeout — so those rely on absence-of-evidence (null) or OSM tags that cannot be treated as authoritative without website corroboration. A notable discrepancy exists: OSM lists phone +1-236-420-2772, while the website's contact page shows 778.484.5445 for the HQ/Pandosy location, flagged as a concern.
concerns: Phone number mismatch: OSM lists +1-236-420-2772 but the website contact page shows 778.484.5445 for the HQ/Pandosy/Landmark location — the OSM number may belong to a specific branch not listed on the contact page.

OSM record has no address field, and the website lists multiple locations (HQ at Landmark/Dickson Ave, Pandosy Village, North at Ellis & Doyle, plus a new Ellis Street location); it is unclear which specific location the OSM node coordinates (49.8640081, -119.4914529) correspond to.
OSM name is 'Bean scene' (lowercase 's') while the website consistently uses 'Bean Scene' — possible OSM tagging inconsistency.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A real, actively operating, publicly accessible specialty coffee shop and roastery with multiple Kelowna locations and a recent OSM check date.
enrichment_extras.notes: The bakery page explicitly states the business is NOT allergy-aware and advises caution for anyone with food allergies — worth surfacing if a dietary amenity field is ever confirmed.
